value.title: Set, down, revive and reshape (workstream 008 s03)
value.summary: `pij pod set` delivers a late parameter to the members that need it; `pij pod down` takes each member down through `pij close --stop` (PRD 007), spares keep-open members with a warning, records the work branch's head and warns when the run is unfrozen; `pij pod up <pod>` brings a closed pod back under revive's rules; members are added and released while it runs.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: `pij pod set` delivers a late parameter to the members that need it; `pij pod down` takes each member down through `pij close --stop` (PRD 007), spares keep-open members with a warning, records the work branch's head and warns when the run is unfrozen; `pij pod up <pod>` brings a closed pod back under revive's rules; members are added and released while it runs.

sections.name: goals
value: Taking a pod down is one command that really stops it, the same way as one seat, and records where its work stood.

value.claim: `pij pod set <pod> <name>=<value>` records the value in the pod folder and sends it to the members whose slots name it, and only them.

`pij pod down <pod>` runs the template's close steps, then for each member not marked keep-open runs the same path as `pij close <seat> --stop` (plan 245): memory first, the recorded process stopped, the prime told of any seat that did not answer, cold seats not woken. A keep-open member (knowledge by default) is named in a warning and left running. Consulted roles are not touched. The pod reads closing until every member is down.

Freeze: when the pod names a work folder, down records its branch and head commit in the pod's log and warns that the run is unfrozen when the folder has uncommitted work. Only a warning: down never refuses on it.

`pij pod up <pod>` on a closed pod revives its members one at a time under today's revive rules (resume, cheap start, the cold warning). `pij pod add <pod> <role|seat>` and `pij pod release <pod> <seat>` reshape a running pod and log it; the template is never changed by a run.
Cost: down is close --stop per member plus at most two git reads in the work folder; set is one delivery per member that needs the value. No loop, poll or timer.

value.title: Set, down, revive and reshape (workstream 008 s03)

value.risk: A member does not answer ready.
value.mitigation: It is left running and the prime is told, as for one seat.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Cost: down: close --stop per member plus two git reads; set: one delivery per member that needs it. No loop, poll or timer.
No permission rule changes (PRD 003); no daemon enforcement of a type's rules; no existing JSON field removed or renamed.
Builds nice-19 through `just shared-build`, one at a time.
